item.title: Implement specified retry delay behavior and focused tests
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to SPEC.md while preserving the documented retry_delay API. Handle every specified validation rule, exhausted-attempt and exhausted-budget boundary, capped exponential backoff with efficient saturation for huge attempts, and an uncapped Retry-After minimum. Add focused standard-library tests covering the specified errors and boundary cases beyond existing basics. Keep the implementation pure, with no clock, sleep, randomness, network, or third-party dependencies. Run the focused tests and commit the work on the item branch.
